definitions.gloss: one united body; unity; acting as one
definitions.explanation: A group acting together with a single purpose. Almost always appears in the fixed pattern {一丸|いちがん}となる ("to become as one") or {一丸|いちがん}となって ("acting as one").

examples.japanese: ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一丸|いちがん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The team came together as one.

examples.japanese: {全社員|ぜんしゃいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一丸|いちがん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}んだ→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
examples.english: All the employees worked toward the goal as one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦{復興|ふっこう}→復興：07590_fukkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{地域住民|ちいきじゅうみん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{自治体|じちたい}→自治体：13946_jichitai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一丸|いちがん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: To rebuild the disaster-stricken area, local residents and the municipal government are continuing their efforts as one.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ (one) + {丸|がん} (round mass, ball). Literally "one lump" — a group fused into a single unit.

FIXED PATTERNS:
- {一丸|いちがん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to unite, to come together as one
- {一丸|いちがん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧: acting as one (adverbial form, by far the most common use)
- 〜⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一丸|いちがん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: ~ unite as one

{一丸|いちがん} is essentially bound to the {〜となる} construction; it does not freely combine with other verbs.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{団結|だんけつ}→団結：15725_danketsu⟧: unity, solidarity — broader noun for being united; can be used freely with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧
- ⟦{結束|けっそく}→結束：13799_kessoku⟧: cohesion, solidarity — emphasizes the bond holding the group together
- ⟦{結集|けっしゅう}→結集：13885_kesshuu⟧: rallying together — implies gathering forces for a purpose
